about: Snowmobile clubs in the Sea to Sky and Sunshine Coast region, kept by hand. Staging area points are approximate. report.auto = true: the winter data job (scripts/build-winter.mjs, ONLY=groom) reads the report page, if its robots.txt allows. check: other pages the job's test run looks at, to find a readable report.

clubs.name: Powder Mountain Snowmobile Club

areas.name: Brandywine snowmobile trail and bowls
areas.note: Booth at the trailhead at the end of the parking lot, at the Callaghan Valley turn-off on Hwy 99. About 9 km groomed (Rec Sites and Trails REC6902).

clubs.pass: $30 + GST per sled per day ($5 off with another BCSF club card); passengers and under-16s with a parent free; season passes sold on the website

report.label: Grooming report
report.note: The club posts its grooming report on its website.

clubs.name: Black Tusk Snowmobile Club

areas.name: Brohm Ridge (Cheekye FSR) and club chalet
areas.note: Cat Lake turn-off 3 km north of Squamish, Cheekye FSR to the gate (about 1350 m), chalet about 1720 m (reserve ahead).

clubs.pass: Season trail pass about $230 (2024/25), sold on the club website; the chalet is extra

report.label: Updates on Facebook
report.note: Posts trail and grooming updates on Facebook, which other sites aren't allowed to read.

clubs.name: Pemberton Valley Snowmobile Club

areas.name: Rutherford trail to the Pemberton Icefield
areas.note: Off Hwy 99 south of Pemberton. Emergency-only cabin at the end.

areas.name: Hurley FSR to Bralorne and Gold Bridge
areas.note: Groomed and managed by the club in winter.

clubs.pass: sold on the club website (price not posted for this season yet)

report.label: Updates on Instagram
report.note: Posts updates on Instagram, which other sites aren't allowed to read.

areas.name: Hurley from the Gold Bridge side
areas.note: Grooms the Hurley from Gold Bridge toward the Lone Goat split.

report.note: No grooming report found online: contact the club.
